description: Main Go source file implementing a documentation translation tool that supports multiple modes (document or segment translation) with parallel processing capabilities. It handles command-line arguments, file ordering, filtering, and invokes translation functions, managing concurrency, logging, and error handling.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the translation tool, parsing flags, initializing components, and orchestrating the translation process based on mode and concurrency.

methods.name: runDocSequential
methods.description: Processes documents sequentially for translation, logging progress and handling errors.

methods.name: runDocParallel
methods.description: Processes documents in parallel using multiple worker goroutines, managing job dispatch and result collection.

methods.name: runSegmentSequential
methods.description: Processes segments of documents sequentially for translation.
